reviews.title: Superb service
reviews.text: Booked onto this return flight not knowing anything about this airline, what a surprise, service,food,flight was superb in every way , great staff, food was tasty and plentiful as were the drinks, loads of movies to watch and massive legroom. Highly recommended
reviews.author: Ashley C

reviews.title: Flight to Beijing
reviews.text: Excellent service, helpful staff, pleasant lounge, easy access to the gate, comfortable seat, very quiet, great plane services. highly recommend the service
reviews.author: Richard A

reviews.title: Refund URGENT NEED BEFORE VISA EXPIRES!!!
reviews.text: Refund URGENT NEED BEFORE VISA EXPIRES!!! I have been stuck in china since 22 April 2022, No help is given from Hainan Airlines! With the only message telling me they are busy processing my request. Means if they say no I would have waited for nothing and will be taken to jail for this company's incompetence!!!!

reviews.title: hi
reviews.text: im here to re-write my crap, you know the crap i wrote as cwilau09 huh, yeah thats not me its big smoke he hacked my account. so dont say its me
reviews.author: Coconut Boy

reviews.title: Still a comfortable airline to fly with
reviews.text: Despite the restructuring of HNA and the airline now part of another Chinese airline group, they manage to keep the good service more or less. The only markedly regression is the onboard meal, kind of fast food or no food. But this is a real issue for manny airlines now with the covid health crisis.
reviews.author: Victor H

reviews.title: Five-star flight experience
reviews.text: Great pre-flight waiting and boarding experience. Flight cabin crew members were friendly, courteous, and helpful. An elderly couple required assistance, and were well taken care of by the crew.
reviews.author: KodoDrummer

reviews.title: Nice equipment, nice service
reviews.text: Of all China Mainland airlines, Hainan has the best service, even in the economy class. A330 was no more or less comfortable in economy than the competition, but had in-seat entertainment system, which helped pass a 3+hour flight. In flight service was pleasant, for some reason I was given an extra welcome by the attendants, even though I am only a silver member in their frequent flyer program. Anyway, a nice touch. Too bad the airline is not a member of any airline alliance to allow cross-cummulation of points. I would fly again when I can.
reviews.author: Maxim B

reviews.title: best so far
reviews.text: I love it. I choose whenever I can. The crew is kind and willing to help and the meals are good - both long and short flights. The seats are the best I have ever tried so far: the seat itself is comfortable and there is a lot of legroom! The services are excellent both on and off board.
reviews.author: Jbar994

reviews.title: Terrible frequent flyer program
reviews.text: Mileage expires after 24 months of inactivity (in comparison to no expiration date set by Delta, United, Jetblue, etc.). Will never fly with Hainan Airlines again
reviews.author: Malala

reviews.title: Delay, delay, delay
reviews.text: Departed one and a half hours late on the scheduled two-hour non-stop flight from Ningbo (NGB) to Guangzhou (CAN). Other than the delay for mechanical issues, the flight went smoothly.
reviews.author: KodoDrummer

reviews.title: It has kept my money for a long time
reviews.text: I got a ticket for a business class, and then, I returned the ticket. I got the confirmation that the ticket was returned. However, weeks later, I am still waiting for my refund. I contacted the customer service multiple times. The same answer: It will be processed. The fact is: I haven't seen my money back. Be careful with this airline. P.S.: (I had to choose a time for "when did you travel", but I did not travel)
reviews.author: Julia

reviews.title: Good price & value
reviews.text: Flew with colleagues in economy class from Sanya (SYX) to Shenzhen (SZX). No complaints. Hit a little turbulence, but we were warned in advance.
reviews.author: KodoDrummer

reviews.title: flight from boston to shanghai
reviews.text: took the flight in January. It was a pleasant experience. Service was good, a whole service kit was handed out to everyone. In-flight entertainment was good, lots of movies to select from. Food was alright. I hope the airline will survive.
reviews.author: Tianhui

reviews.title: Flight from San Jose California to Bangkok Thailand
reviews.text: Flight from San Jose California to Bangkok Thailand The flight from San Jose California was great the flight from Beijing to Bangkok was way below standards was an old airplane the business class was terrible I’ll never fly this airline again
reviews.author: Tim H

reviews.title: No Credit , dishonest ,refuse for refund
reviews.text: Booked on their website, this company canceled the flight only two days before departure, and after two and half months , they refused to give refund, they announced false flights info to financing their own debts before going bankruptcy. I guess
reviews.author: Kevin Lenoire

reviews.title: trash company took money and canceled flights
reviews.text: My assistant is an idiot, I just forgot to tell her not to book from this airline, guess what, This airline canceled their flight two days before the departure date again, did not even send cell phone message to alert customers ! ,that I had to find by email almost one day later and they refused to give refund. this airline has no respect to customers and just keep scamming people, it was really difficult to find alternative flights since was too close to departure date, Stay away from this airlines if you don't want your business or leisure trips to end in a disaster or stranded in the airport only to find that they CANCELED your flight out of whim .
reviews.author: Guy

reviews.title: false flights and poor customer service
reviews.text: I suspect that this airline was making a scam that they put false relatively cheaper flights info in mid-Feb , here is what happened: after I booked it, around three days before departure , they mysteriously canceled all flights in mid-Feb. so i can not even change to a different flights, and so I was calling for refund and they just told me that they can not refund me at moment,since they have been experiencing high volume of refund, of course you can not, that was when i realized this whole scam. A friendly reminder , just stay away from this airlines, and anyone would be much better off in the future.
reviews.author: Guy

reviews.title: Delayed flight
reviews.text: For a delayed flight, Hainan airlines has promised a reimbursement of only 200 RMB. We agreed on all the details in November 2019. But when I ask where this amount is, they start asking for my bank details again. That has been repeated three times. My conclusion - never fly with Hainan airlines, you will get nothing if you are delayed
reviews.author: TanyaHolland2014

reviews.title: DO NOT BOOK TICKETS WITH HAINAN!
reviews.text: I used to fly with Hainan Airlines about 1-3 x year. This year we had to cancel our flight due to the corona virus. We cancelled on Jan 25th and were told we would get a refund. 5 weeks later, STILL NO REFUND! We have called multiple times (which takes forever just to get a rep on the phone) only to be told "We are very busy", "you have to wait lonber", "We don't know when you will get a refund, maybe 90 days?" RIDICULOUS! Also, emailed may times, also a waste of time. I am going back to UNITED AIRLINES.
reviews.author: MAS

reviews.title: No one answer the call
reviews.text: I was in Beijing when Coronavirus outbreak occurs. My original return flight with HNA was on Feb 7 from PEK to Chongqin and then JFK. As US closes airport/flight, a lot of flight between US and China are cancelled. Including mine. So I start calling HNA to change my flilght. I was put on hold for several hours with no one answering. After 10+ tries, I finally got hold of someone at HNA. They were able to change my flight to Jan 31 . But on Jan 28, I got a text message saying my flight was cancelled. So I called again and after several hours, they change my flight to Jan 30. Then on Jan 29, I got another message that my flight is cancelled again. I tried to call them, but no one answers. So I drove to the airport to HNA counter. The agent there was able to rebook my flight to Seattle instead. I understand a lot of flights are cancelled and agent are busy. But they should have put more agents to answer the call. Their APP and website is not working at all. It was still showing my original flight even though it was changed multiple times. I have no way to rebook it online. So I have to do the old fashion way. Fortunately, I was able to get back to US. I am hesitant to fly with them again in the future. The business class lie-flat seat on this flight is good. I got sanitized blanket. But no pillow. There is only one meal to choose from. No alcohol drink at all. I can understand that this is due to coronavirus.
reviews.author: kxz255

reviews.title: needs lots of improvement
reviews.text: First impression, the wingtip VIP lounge at JFK is way out of league. It is small, crowded. Virtually no food. I mostly fly business class with other airlines, they have much better lounge with better food, drink, service. I understand HNA has financial issue and can’t afford to build their VIP lounge everywhere. But why not join an alliance and use their lounge. On board experience is better. Jfk to CTU flight business classes seat is in 1-2-1 configuration at about 45 degree angle. HNA has 3 business class configuration on different planes. This is another problem. They need to consolidate into a single business product.
reviews.author: kxz255

reviews.title: flight was cancelled without any notice
reviews.text: I just had very bad experience from this airline last month. My flight was cancelled without any notice. I had to pay lots more to purchase ticket from different airline. My schedule was also screwed. Their service phone took very long time and they refused to provide any compensation. This airline attack people using low price. The cost goes lots high if part of your trip is cancelled. Good luck if you want to try this airline.
reviews.author: J H

reviews.title: Flying to China
reviews.text: Flying to China is an experience in itself. The staff is very detail oriented and always willing to take care of you. The seat was comfortable and when you are ready to sleep, the staff will make up your bed for you, sheets and all. The food was always hot and very tasty. Whether you fell asleep or not, you could eat at any time you desire. Always waiting for you. No doubt the airplane ride was amazing (Boeing 787) the lighting and the view out the large windows was fantastic. The best part was on landing, I have flown many miles and the touch down on this ride was one I will never forget. Never even felt the plane actually "bump" the ground. The smoothest landing I have ever experienced. Nice to have pilot's who know how to land an aircraft.
reviews.author: grahambwarbreck

reviews.title: Long haul from Beijing to Mexico
reviews.text: Found this long haul deal to Mexico City via Skyscanner during the Christmas season. It was an extremely full flight probably because it is near the festive period. The downside was I couldn't check in via online check in which means that I had to sit separately from my traveling mates. The seats and legroom were of similar levels to other economy airlines. There is inflight entertainment but the collection of movies are not as up to date or extensive compared to other commercial airlines. The screen also had occasional issues with the touchscreen and tends to have some lagging issues. The biggest issue I had was with the hygenie of the restrooms, it was barely into half the flight time and every single available cubicle were already of an unbearable standard. I literally wanted to retreat when I opened the door. The floor was wet and sticky and tissues were just thrown all over the floor. But it's an almost twelve hour flight so it is inevitable to avoid visits to the restrooms. However, I believe this is attributed more by the behavior of the passengers rather than the negligence of the crew. The crew were generally friendly and attentive to the passengers' needs. The flight stops at Tijuana for a fuel refill and you would need to clear the customs with your carry on luggage. The wait before you re-board the same plane is brief. Overall, the price is unbeatable for a long haul from china to mexico city. The toilet mess will probably be much more manageable during non peak seasons.
reviews.author: manda h

reviews.title: Terrible long haul option, and worst booking management website
reviews.text: Flown with HA a few times now. As a long haul option I give zero stars. 13 hour flights China-UK, and the meal/refreshments were easily the worst I've experienced on that journey (flown with four other airlines previously: China Eastern, China Southern, BA, and Virgin). The menu said that there would be various snacks brought around between meals. In fact there were no snacks whatsoever. None. Even worse, there was no tea or coffee brought around at all. There were hot drinks available in the galley, but no announcement was made at any time during the flight to inform passengers of this. Just very very poor for such a long flight. Also delays both ways, waiting for another HA connecting flight, the passengers of which were allowed to board before the rest of us who had been waiting for hours. Both ways. Considering that this economy ticket was more expensive than any of the four airlines mentioned above, and the level of service far inferior, then the experience was unacceptable. Their website, unbelievably, offers no manage booking options unless you actually book the tickets on their website. So, if you buy your ticket through a third party site like expedia, kayak, trip.com, etc., then you can forget about using the ticket number or reference to choose your seats on the HA website. Unlike every other airline I've flown with, you cannot choose your seats unless you book direct from their website. Just very poor indeed. I've given two stars purely for short haul experiences, where HA's inadequacies re food/refreshments, inability to choose seats ahead of time, etc., and even delays, are all less of an issue. Suffice to say, however, that I will never fly long haul with Hainan Airlines again.
reviews.author: Jason S

reviews.title: Fly Hainan
reviews.text: This is the third time I used Hainan to fly to China and back. Love flying with them, they are in my top four of preferred airlines. Went out of their way this trip to accommodate my allergy. Flew to China economy and back to Seattle using my miles I flew first class this trip. Other than the obvious perks like the flat bed, different foods & jammies, same great service in both cabins of the plane.
reviews.author: Hane G

reviews.title: An efficient and comfortable flight
reviews.text: Firstly we were delighted to be able to fly direct from Manchester to Beijing. Being tall I had concerns about likely legroom, but found that there was plenty and I was very comfortable. The staff were helpful and everything ran like clockwork. I was able to get several hours of sleep both going out and coming back. My husband and son enjoyed the good choice of movies and games available, and we all found the in flight meals good. I would also add that the staff uniforms were absolutely charming, and the safety briefing beautifully choreographed. Overall excellent.
reviews.author: Therealsnoggy

reviews.title: Bit of a curate's egg
reviews.text: I flew Bru-Pek-Bkk. Firstly, the (very) good. The cabin crew on both flights were excellent: friendly and efficient. Similarly, the staff in the lounge in T2, Beijing were also excellent. In fact, I think that this lounge was probably the best that I have ever visited! Spacious, excellent food, excellent showers, wide range of newspapers. The ok: Hainin use the Diamond Lounge@Brussels, which is about the best of a poor bunch: Food, bed, entertainment system on the Bru-Pek leg (A330) was fine: Nothing to write home about either positively or negatively. As others have noted; the pyjamas are a nice touch Now the not-so-good. Pek-Bkk is a 5 hour flight in an old 737; reclining seats and no entertainment system: I expected more. The biggest oversight: I try to be a vegetarian, although I occasionally eat seafood, which is just as well as there was no vegetarian - let alone vegan - option on either flight. I think that, perhaps(?), a vegetarian option could have been prepared for me on the BRU-PEK leg but certainly not on the PEK-BKK leg. I wrote to Hainin about this and received a garbled reply, the gist of which (I think) was that vegetarian meals have to be ordered in advance. Really? In today's world?
reviews.author: freescreenname

reviews.title: Not up to standard
reviews.text: The food in the flight was not good, so bring your own food or snack. Only frequent flyer will get a bottle of water at the beginning of the flight, and the service attendant don't bother to walk around to provide water during the 13 hours flight. Snack (cookies/cracker) are provided at the gallery, and they come in bulk not individual pack. The main problem for my experience is the online service. 1) you can't manage or change seat online even when i check in; 2) i paid extra to get a seat but the seat assignment showed a different seat online vs to what i reserved. 3) if you want to claim your missing miles, you have to do it over the phone. I am realistic that i can't expect much in terms of poor service and bad food, but basic online service should be standard.This is a disappointment.
reviews.author: pams1122014

reviews.title: DO NOT FLY EVER
reviews.text: This airline ticket purchased through JustFly is the absolute worst experience I have ever had. They don’t sell airline tickets, they sell change and cancellation fees. They charged me 400 dollars in fees for a 413 dollar ticket. They would not allow changes of any kind without cancelling and rebooking and charging, charging, charging. They would just politely explain that another 200 fee would be incurred. Do not fly them. Don’t do it!!!
reviews.author: Briteday2day

reviews.title: Direct flight with good price
reviews.text: The price was quite good. It was under $700 for direct round flights from Boston to Beijing. The food was mediocre. There were two meals, but about 10 hours apart. They did serve sandwiches upon request, when I waked up hungry. Unfortunately, the options for good movies and TV shows were limited. Overall, it was not bad experience.
reviews.author: Jerry C

reviews.title: Chinese airline
reviews.text: This airline was a very pleasant surprise. Their service is excellent, the planes clean, food is good,and seating quite comfortable. We did an 12 hour flight and it went very fast. Would recommend anyone flying into china to use this service....Hope they start to fly out of other states in Australia.
reviews.author: Robski888

reviews.title: Direct flight and excellent customer service
reviews.text: Friendly and helpful staff at check in. In flight service was great, very attentive and plenty of food and drinks. Food was lovely with good choices. Clean toilets. Good choice of movies, tv and music. Phone charging point in seat. No seats are comfortable for 10 hours but these weren't bad at all.
reviews.author: Annadeegan

reviews.title: First Time on Hainan Airlines
reviews.text: Great Airlines to take from LAX to Beijing via Changsa. Did have to board bus at LAX to arrive at plane as they did not have own gate ramp. Need to carry luggage up stairs to get on plane. Fortunately it was not raining. Saw 3 movies on my flight. Toy Story 4, Yesterday, and The Biggest Little Farm, Had 2 hot meals and snack on longest leg of flt, 13 hours. Helpful staff. Newer plane as no window shades but one presses touch screen button to darken windows.
reviews.author: margarita

reviews.title: Hainan Airlines
reviews.text: Flew from Chicago O'Hare airport to Beijing on a long nearly 13 hour flight. Comfortable as any economy seat can be on such a long flight. Meals served were al chinese meals but decent if you like that kind of food. I didn't like the food nor the juices as they were really orange drink and orange juice of somewhat poor quality. The attendants where good but no where near friendly. Overall the flight was very smooth and I would fly Hainan Airlines again just for the value cost.
reviews.author: jackiendaddy

reviews.title: Hurrah for Hainan
reviews.text: We booked this new route for a trip to China for Thanksgiving. We were a bit worried because the price was fantastic but 15hrs long in the back of the plane. What a great experience! Check -in was simple, flight left on time plus two pieces of free checked luggage. The flight left at 12:00 am, meal was served shortly after. When meal service was over, lights were perfectly dimmed. Flight attendants were all very kind and kept the bathrooms spotless! Snacks and beverages were available in the back of the plane at all times, it was so nice to be able to stretch back there for few minutes every once and awhile. We will definitely use Hainan again! Great experience!
reviews.author: lovetravel0828

reviews.title: Hinan Airlines
reviews.text: The flight with Hainan Airlines is a direct flight, comfort, good service, only the meals are poor and have much to improve, otherwise- it is recommended .
reviews.author: Aga Schwartz

reviews.title: Hainan Airlines
reviews.text: Had a great flight going to Shanghai, food was good and I was lucky enough to get the new seat which was very spacious. The nice touch was pj's that were good quality. Service on other airlines have been much better but they were all friendly enough! I would fly again with Hainan if like it was the price was considerably cheaper.
reviews.author: Travel2theSun

reviews.title: Great flight
reviews.text: Great flight but long. Plenty of movies, meals and snacks. Flight attendants were friendly and helpful.
reviews.author: skidkid6119

reviews.title: Good value
reviews.text: Good value for your money, good services and 2 pieces of free checked luggages. Food and seat size are regular standard.
reviews.author: Travelholic

reviews.title: A pleasant experience
reviews.text: I booked a flight with hainan airlines and it was a good experience. I definitely recommend to fly with this company .the seats are very comfortable. The crew is very friendly and polite.
reviews.author: ronmish

reviews.title: Great Airline
reviews.text: I was very happy with Hainan Airlines. As soon as I walked on the plane, I felt comfortable and it looked clean and well kept. They provided a blanket, pillow, ear plugs, ear phones, toothbrush, toothpaste, and eye mask. Great movie selection and the food was good as well. Great service, I would definitely fly with them again.
reviews.author: Michelle M

reviews.title: Superb!
reviews.text: From beginning to end the flights both directions were superb. The service is second to none. I was concerned about the length of the flight, 14 hours, but it went by much more quickly than I had anticipated. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Elaine M

reviews.title: Excellent value for the money
reviews.text: My first trip with Hainan and I was pleasantly surprised by how great it was! We departed on time, staff was very friendly (most beautiful uniforms), very modern & clean airplane, staff spoke English, everything was wonderful. Will definitely fly again!
reviews.author: Claudia R

reviews.title: The service is good, however the seat was not functional and not comfortable
reviews.text: SEAT 39C has problem to recline. The airline crew member said they would report this to the mechanic after the flight. Since the flight was full, there was no other seat for me. It was a very uncomfortable 12-hour flying experience. The overall service is good, but the seat caused a problem.
reviews.author: 8bumblebee8

reviews.title: Wow what a 5 star service. Wonderfull experience.
reviews.text: I had a flight from Taipei to Beijing to Prague to Brussels. My flight from Beijing to Prague had a delay of 1,5 hours and the layover for my connecting flight in Prague 1,75hours. So I was about to miss my connection to Brussels. The Hainan Airlines staff in Beijing helped me out so wonderfull with directions on how to arrange things in Prague. Also on board I had extra space and premium service to make my delay as comfortable as possible. Someone of Hainan Airlines arranged things for me in Prague. Just wonderfull. I have had many flights worldwide with many different airlines and I can only say that the service of Hainan Airlines will always stay as one of my top experiences. I can only recommend this airline. For me a five star rating for sure.
reviews.author: SG42

reviews.title: Last Minute Business Trip to Meet Important Client
reviews.text: There was this very last minute important client to meet in Shanghai and a flight was required to be booked to fly from Shenzhen to Shanghai literally the following day. The preferred airlines to fly with in China are Shenzhen Airlines and Hainan Airlines. As expected Hainan Airlines was prompt and on schedule with no delays, flight staff both on the ground and during the flight were courteous, attentive and professional. The Boeing 737 single aisle aircraft was clean, spacious and comfortable. Shenzhen Airlines and especially with this Hainan Airlines flight shall always be the preferred carrier to travel with in China.
reviews.author: @cdo

reviews.title: Best Business class so far
reviews.text: Just perfect business class: very attentive staff, personal food serving by chef, amenities and even smell!! Super comfortable and really high end.
reviews.author: DomSila

reviews.title: poor services
reviews.text: We fly from Shanghai to San Jose but it transit in Beijing. When I arrived in Shanghai Airport, I was told the luggage is only check thru Shanghai and we will have to pick up to check in for the Beijing-San jose leg on another terminal. It's on the same airline, why do we need to do that? The worst was there is a older female agent at the Shanghai counter. I was asking if I would be able to make it with the transit time. She was super not helpful, and pretty much said you are on your own. Once landed in Beijing. They will put you on a bus to drive at least 10min to luggage. There was a Hainan airline agent holding a paper said 'Transfer' but he was totally unhelpful too. Then you have to take all the luggage and walk another 10min to another terminal to board the international flight. To make matter worse, the Shanghai-Beijing leg was late. We barely make it before they close luggage check for the San Jose flight.
reviews.author: Coco

reviews.title: Overall evaluation
reviews.text: This is my third time flying Hainan. Their flight schedule have changed from Noon time to 1:10am, which caused date confusion for me! Couple of years later, they still don't offer online check in which wasted a lot of my time lining up at the YVR airport waiting for their counter to open.Also they started charging for the middle section seats! Overall, the flight was fine and relatively comfortable, however, their food could use some improvement. My biggest complain is I couldn't understand a word of their English announcements! They need to improve their english announcements and their staff english level! However, for the price and the direct flight to Shenzhen,I will fly again on Hainan
reviews.author: Francis
